item.title: SNAP Expands European Truck Parking Network with Over 120 New Locations
item.description: Digital parking payment provider SNAP has added more than 120 new truck parking sites across Europe, marking its entry into seven new countries: Austria, Bulgaria, Czechia, Greece, Hungary, Italy, and Romania. This expansion follows SNAP’s acquisition of OTRA’s technology platforms and IT infrastructure, enabling the company to enhance its services and reach more customers.
